title: 安里屋ゆんた（前奏＋1節・基礎練習版）
composer: 宮良長包 (Chohu Miyara, 1883–1939), based on the traditional Yaeyama song
scope: New monophonic elementary study: introduction and one verse, honchoshi C–F–C, uniform one-beat cells at 85 BPM and a two-beat final note. It is a beginner practice arrangement, not a synchronization or full transcription of a teacher's recording.
license_scope: Music Stack dedicates its newly entered symbolic MIDI and elementary study arrangement to CC0. This does not license third-party sheet layouts, lyrics, recordings, or teaching arrangements.

rights_basis.composer_fact: The Miyara Chohu Association records the composer's death on 1939-06-29 and lists Asatoya Yunta among his works.
rights_basis.term_basis: The composer's underlying published melody is public domain in Japan. The 2018 term extension does not revive expired copyrights. Modern publisher and performer contributions are not covered by that status.

melody_cross_checks.credit: 伊禮俊一・公式初心者レッスン
melody_cross_checks.use: Cross-check the basic introduction, first-verse pitch contours and honchoshi relation. No lyrics, files, recording or publisher layout bundled.

melody_cross_checks.credit: 宮里英克沖縄三線教室・公開教材
melody_cross_checks.use: Visual cross-check of common melody phrases and honchoshi. Publisher PDF, lyrics, compact ornaments, strike annotations and distinct performance phrasing are not bundled.

changes: New plain-symbol practice entry using the basic shared melody. Straight one-beat durations replace expressive phrasing; ornamental strikes and compressed clusters are omitted, one verse is used, section pauses and a held final note are added. Guide sound is synthesized by the existing instrument voice. For authentic timing, ornament and singing, use the linked teacher lesson.
lyrics: No lyric text is bundled. Existing teacher video/PDF references and local personal lyric entry remain available.
